stories.title: University pauses Shakespeare move after backlash
stories.summary: The planned move from Mason Croft is paused while the university explores future options.

stories.title: Jury told prisoner admitted £20,000 killing
stories.summary: A jury hears allegations surrounding the fatal shooting of Harun Khan in March 2008.

stories.title: Man guilty of manslaughter after street attack
stories.summary: Kevin Siviter is cleared of murder but found guilty of manslaughter over Michael Bennett's death.

stories.title: Burst water pipe forces schools to shut early
stories.summary: The outage is affecting homes, businesses and schools across parts of Stourbridge.

stories.title: Man pleads guilty to harassing Jess Phillips MP
stories.summary: Lee Owens, 47, will be sentenced next year for sending aggressive and threatening emails to the MP.

stories.title: 'Festive toy appeal will keep Amelia's memory going'
stories.summary: It is in memory of Amelia Kolpa, who died in March after getting 300,000 eighth birthday cards.

stories.title: Third man charged over Raise the Colours flags disorder
stories.summary: Julian Keane, 53, is charged with causing serious injury by dangerous driving.

stories.title: 'Flying doctor saved my sight after dogs attacked me'
stories.summary: Colwall woman whose sight was saved by a Midlands Air Ambulance doctor is backing calls for funding to ensure a doctor is on every flight.

stories.title: 'Mentors and job training in schools could help end Neets crisis'
stories.summary: A Oldbury school working with a mentoring charity describes its volunteers as "superb role models".

stories.title: Patient of jailed surgeon recalled to hospital before her death
stories.summary: Gillian Hudson died of metastatic breast cancer in 2022, aged 63.

stories.title: Speeding drunk driver jailed after killing boy, 9
stories.summary: James Connors was already disqualified from driving and also had cocaine in his system.

stories.title: Killer driver mowed down man and reversed over him
stories.summary: Momodou Johm is found guilty of murder after reversing over his victim twice in Birmingham city centre.
